decision: Deferred: cold panic outlining improves compiler CPU time and managed parameter runtime, but regresses text scanning. Consistent 32-byte loop alignment does not resolve the regression. No compiler or test change from these prototypes is accepted.

diff --git a/core/compiler/x64.jo b/core/compiler/x64.jo
index 4702fa01..4352e91c 100644
--- a/core/compiler/x64.jo
+++ b/core/compiler/x64.jo
@@ -1650,6 +1650,29 @@ emit_memeq = (d: int, a: int, bb: int, count: int, flags: bool = false, strings:
 fused_cc = -1
 fuse_skip = -1             # an instruction folded into the branch after it
 
+cold_skip_until = -1
+cold_paths: (int, int, int)[]       # first instruction, end, failure-branch fixup
+
+# Keep nonreturning failure paths out of the hot instruction stream. Recognize
+# only a location constant followed by a panic call, or a panic call alone.
+outline_panic = (pos: int, condition: int) -> bool:
+    if dbg_on or fused_cc >= 16 or pos + 2 >= ir.code.len(): return false
+    call_at = pos + 1
+    if ir.code[call_at].op == .daddr: call_at += 1
+    end_at = call_at + 1
+    if end_at >= ir.code.len(): return false
+    call = ir.code[call_at]
+    if call.op != .call or call.c != 1 or ir.code[end_at].op != .end: return false
+    cc = fused_cc
+    if cc < 0:
+        r = reg_of(condition, RAX)
+        op_rr(0x85, true, r, r)
+        cc = CC_NE
+    cold_paths.push((pos + 1, end_at, jcc32(cc)))
+    cold_skip_until = end_at
+    fused_cc = -1
+    true
+
 emit_ins = (pos: int, ins: Ins):
     op = ins.op
     d = int(ins.dst)
@@ -2312,6 +2335,7 @@ emit_ins = (pos: int, ins: Ins):
                 else: nop_pad((8 - code.len() % 8) % 8)
             xctl.push(XCtl(1, code.len(), [], []))
         if_:
+            if outline_panic(pos, a): return
             fx: int[]
             if fused_cc >= 0:
                 cc = fused_cc
@@ -2444,6 +2468,8 @@ x64_function = ():
     else: allocate()
     layout_frame()
     xctl = []
+    cold_skip_until = -1
+    cold_paths.clear()
     fused_cc = -1
     fuse_skip = -1
     fold_load = -1
@@ -2466,6 +2492,7 @@ x64_function = ():
     save_next = 0
     save_active.clear()
     loop pos in 0.. and ins in ir.code:
+        if pos <= cold_skip_until: continue
         line_row(int(ins.pos))
         if dbg_on: dbg_pos[pos] = code.len()
         if ci < call_pos.len() and call_pos[ci] == pos and save_list.len() > 0:
@@ -2490,6 +2517,17 @@ x64_function = ():
                     else: ra_save_cost += 2 * call_w[ci]
         else: emit_ins(pos, ins)
         if ci < call_pos.len() and call_pos[ci] == pos: ci += 1
+    # The ordinary body terminates before these failure-only stubs. Allocation
+    # still describes the original branch point; jumping here preserves those
+    # register/stack values, and nonreturning calls need no live-value saves.
+    loop path in cold_paths:
+        patch_here(path.2)
+        fused_cc = -1
+        loop pos in [path.0..path.1):
+            ins = ir.code[pos]
+            line_row(int(ins.pos))
+            emit_ins(pos, ins)
+        b(0x0F); b(0x0B)           # a nonreturning call must not fall through
     if dbg_on:
         dbg_pos[ir.code.len()] = code.len()
         dbg_function(fn_start, body_start, X64_DWREG, XMM, 17, 6)

diff --git a/tests/python_misc/test_sloppy_core.py b/tests/python_misc/test_sloppy_core.py
index 260697ae..0c0bcb88 100644
--- a/tests/python_misc/test_sloppy_core.py
+++ b/tests/python_misc/test_sloppy_core.py
@@ -10754,3 +10754,40 @@ def test_core_string_equality_guard_pages(compiler, tmp_path, release):
     assert built.returncode == 0, built.stdout + built.stderr
     ran = subprocess.run([binary], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=False)
     assert ran.returncode == 42, ran.stdout + ran.stderr
+
+@pytest.mark.core_quick
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('release', [False, True], ids=['default', 'release'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad_position', [-1, 0, 7, 13], ids=['valid', 'first', 'middle', 'last'])
+def test_core_cold_bounds_with_live_values(compiler, tmp_path, release, bad_position):
+    # Keep many indices and loaded values live across separate bounds checks.
+    # Deferred panic code must use the registers/slots at its original edge.
+    parameters = ', '.join(f'a{i}: int' for i in range(14))
+    reads = '\n'.join(f'    v{i} = xs[a{i}]' for i in range(14))
+    total = ' + '.join(f'v{i}' for i in range(14))
+    indices = list(range(14))
+    if bad_position >= 0:
+        indices[bad_position] = 14 + bad_position
+    values = ', '.join(str(i) for i in range(1, 15))
+    arguments = ', '.join(map(str, indices))
+    source = tmp_path / 'cold-bounds.jo'
+    source.write_text(f'@noinline\nprobe = (xs: int[], {parameters}) -> int:\n{reads}\n'
+                      f'    {total}\nmain = () -> int: probe([{values}], {arguments}) - 63\n')
+    binary = tmp_path / 'bounds'
+    flags = ['--release'] if release else []
+    built = subprocess.run([compiler, 'build', source, *flags, '-o', binary],
+                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False)
+    assert built.returncode == 0, built.stdout + built.stderr
+    ran = subprocess.run([binary], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=False)
+    if bad_position < 0:
+        assert ran.returncode == 42, ran.stdout + ran.stderr
+    else:
+        assert ran.returncode != 0, ran.stdout + ran.stderr
+        assert re.search(rf'index {indices[bad_position]} out of bounds \(length 14[):]', ran.stderr), ran.stderr
+        assert f'{source.name}:{3 + bad_position}:' in ran.stderr, ran.stderr
+    objdump = shutil.which('objdump')
+    if platform.system() == 'Linux' and platform.machine().lower() in ('x86_64', 'amd64') and objdump:
+        assembly = subprocess.check_output([objdump, '-d', '--disassemble=probe', binary], text=True)
+        returned = re.search(r'\bret\b', assembly)
+        panics = list(re.finditer(r'\bcall\s+[^\n]*<__panic_bounds>', assembly))
+        assert returned and panics, assembly
+        assert all(call.start() > returned.start() for call in panics), assembly

notes: Focused 15-pair pilot confirms original default text regression at 1.0349x and release at 1.0514x; aligned text is 1.0737x and 1.0707x.
Original six compilation comparisons against preceding compiler pass at 0.913-0.955x CPU time; this gain alone does not justify accepting a runtime regression.
The focused pilot also confirms managed-parameter benefits; preserve the prototype for later reconsideration after general loop/code-layout improvements.
